decision.reason: [ev-bd329a64ec5d] is a single highlight line saying the Image Automation APIs reached general availability. It covers three kinds (ImagePolicy, ImageRepository, ImageUpdateAutomation), so it describes more than one change. It does not name the API group or the version that became GA, and it gives no before/after state, such as whether beta versions are deprecated, still served or removed. To write the subject and change, we need the CRD/API version diff or the upgrade-guide section that names the new version and what happens to the earlier ones.
